vulnerable.description: The default comes from a module-level constant set to True.

excerpts.symbol: fix_sql endpoint (calls generate_sql with the default)

data_flow.source: Rows returned by the model-requested intermediate SQL query (customer data in the harness).
data_flow.sink: Prompt sent to the external LLM provider through submit_prompt (and printed by log).

validation.summary: Same behavioural test as the base case, run on this variant: the attack or leak happens only with the vulnerable file and normal use works with both.

assumptions: The database holds personal or confidential data that must not leave the organisation.
The LLM is an external provider (Vanna's typical setup).
limitations: No live LLM inference is run.
If the owner explicitly opts in, sending data is intended; the label concerns the unsafe default only.
Retrieval, prompt building and SQL extraction are stubbed.
Refactored variant of vanna_llm_sees_data_001: same application group and same split; it is not an independent sample.
